problem_statement:
Site Forge has 256 Configio-backed physical I/O claims for MSCATL_CP3, 29 Configio words, and a physical EIP hardware topology, but zero claims resolve deterministically.

Investigate why the logical Configio evidence cannot currently bind to physical modules.

Identify what Site Forge appears not to understand, what evidence supports your hypothesis, what contradicts it, and what deterministic decoding rule should be investigated.

Do not assign physical endpoints.
Use the provided read-only Site Forge tools as needed.
Inspect multiple Configio words (inputs/outputs, Low/High pairs, different catalogs) and explicitly search for counterexamples.
If the evidence is insufficient, return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
constraints: Every important claim must cite tool-returned evidence
Must search for counterexamples across multiple words
